item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=distinction+between+thermodynamic+persistence+and+heritable+information+storage+in+prebiotic+chemical+networks&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1007/978-3-319-53512-8_6\", \"title\": [\"Exchange of Information During Prebiotic Evolution\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-53512-8_6\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2017]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.6493658\", \"title\": [\"Distinction Thermodynamic Economics (DTE): A Unified Theory of Economic Phenomena from Information-Theoretic First Principles\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>We propose Distinction Thermodynamic Economics (DTE), a theory that derives the core structures of economics-markets, firms, money, credit, financial crises, and macroeconomic aggregates-from a single primitive: the distinction, defined as a partition of the state space. Five axioms (self-maintaining agent, distinction primitive, finite budget, dissipation floor, power-weighted institutions) generate a three-layer cost function spanning physics (Landauer erasure), cognition (MDL complexity), and social verification/enforcement. From this base we derive: (i) a four-component decomposition of the interest rate into time-degradation, assessment, enforcement, and distinction-uncertainty premia; (ii) money as an optimal rate-distortion compression of multi-dimensional distinctions; (iii) an optimal coarse-graining problem (C⋆) whose fixed points are macroeconomic aggregates (GDP, price level, unemployment) and whose discontinuous jumps constitute a unified taxonomy of phase transitions-financial crises, technological revolutions, institutional transformations, and inflation; (iv) a value function grounded in future distinction-cost reduction; (v) prices as Lagrange multipliers on joint distinction-cost constraints, dissolving the subjective/objective value dichotomy. Existing theories emerge as classical limits: Arrow-Debreu (Γ → 0, B → ∞), rational inattention (DTE minus the social layer), behavioural biases (budget-optimal heuristics), Coase (Σ market vs. Σ firm), Akerlof (distinction-cost critical point), Modigliani-Miller (Γ → 0), Diamond-Dybvig (processing-capacity bottleneck), and Minsky (endogenous λ-accumulation).
